Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein the contact elements are positioned to avoid obstruction of the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __and does not interfere with the heater__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled)

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising at least an inner layer and an outer layer__.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is __positioned within or adjacent to__ the tube.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a separate__ pressure measuring tube connection __that is distinct from the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __positioned upstream of the breathing mask__.

Claim 22 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece __having a water chamber__ disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __having a tensile strength of at least 5 MPa__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __comprising a resistive wire or film element__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that __both an electric connection for power delivery and a pneumatic connection for gas flow are simultaneously provided__ when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that __both an electric connection for power delivery and a pneumatic connection for gas flow are simultaneously provided__ when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Previously presented): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.
